professions.name: Medical School (MD/DO)
professions.tagline: Diagnose, treat, and lead patient care as a physician.
professions.description: Allopathic (MD) and osteopathic (DO) medical schools train physicians across every specialty. Applications run through AMCAS, AACOMAS, or TMDSAS, and admissions weigh coursework, the MCAT, clinical and research experience, and competencies beyond the classroom.

resources.note: AAMC Medical School Admission Requirements search tool
resources.label: MSAR - Medical School Admission Requirements

resources.note: Students & Residents official course requirement guidance
resources.label: Required Premedical Coursework and Competencies (AAMC)

professions.name: Dental School (DDS/DMD)
professions.tagline: Care for teeth, gums, and oral health as a dentist.
professions.description: Dental schools grant the DDS or DMD degree. Most programs apply through ADEA AADSAS. Admissions review prerequisite science coursework, the DAT, and clinical shadowing.

professions.name: Physician Assistant (PA)
professions.tagline: Practice medicine as part of a physician-led team.
professions.description: PA programs award a master's degree and apply through CASPA. Programs value patient-care hours, prerequisite sciences, and the GRE at some schools.

resources.note: Search all PA programs and their course requirements
resources.label: CASPA Program Directory (PAEA)

professions.name: Nursing (ABSN/MEPN)
professions.tagline: Deliver hands-on patient care and advance the profession.
professions.description: This planner covers entry-to-practice nursing programs for students who already hold a non-nursing bachelor's degree: Accelerated BSN (ABSN) and Master's Entry programs (MEPN). The AACN member directory lists accredited programs nationwide.

professions.name: Pharmacy (PharmD)
professions.tagline: Master medications and optimize drug therapy.
professions.description: Doctor of Pharmacy programs apply through PharmCAS. Admissions review prerequisite coursework and, at some schools, the PCAT.

professions.name: Physical Therapy (DPT)
professions.tagline: Restore movement and function through rehabilitation.
professions.description: Doctor of Physical Therapy programs apply through PTCAS. Prerequisites emphasize anatomy, physiology, and observation hours.

professions.name: Occupational Therapy (OTD/MOT)
professions.tagline: Help people participate in the activities of daily life.
professions.description: Occupational therapy programs are accredited by ACOTE and apply through OTCAS. Programs award master's or doctoral degrees.

professions.name: Optometry (OD)
professions.tagline: Examine, diagnose, and treat the visual system.
professions.description: Doctor of Optometry programs apply through OptomCAS. Admissions review prerequisite sciences and the OAT.

professions.name: Veterinary Medicine (DVM)
professions.tagline: Care for the health of animals across species.
professions.description: Doctor of Veterinary Medicine programs apply through VMCAS. VMSAR is the authoritative admission-requirements reference.

professions.name: Podiatric Medicine (DPM)
professions.tagline: Specialize in the foot, ankle, and lower extremity.
professions.description: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine programs are represented by AACPM and apply through AACPMAS.

resources.label: American Association of Colleges of Podiatric Medicine (AACPM)

professions.name: Prosthetics & Orthotics (MSPO)
professions.tagline: Design and fit devices that restore mobility.
professions.description: Orthotist and prosthetist programs award master's degrees and are accredited through CAAHEP/NCOPE.

professions.name: Genetic Counseling (MS)
professions.tagline: Guide patients through genetic risk and testing.
professions.description: Genetic counseling programs are accredited by ACGC and award a master's degree. Applications use the GC Admissions Match.

professions.name: Dietetics (RD/RDN)
professions.tagline: Translate nutrition science into patient care.
professions.description: Registered dietitian nutritionist pathways require an accredited program and supervised practice, listed in the ACEND program directory.

professions.name: Speech-Language Pathology (MS/MA)
professions.tagline: Diagnose and treat communication and swallowing disorders.
professions.description: SLP programs award master's degrees and apply through CSDCAS. ASHA EdFind lists accredited graduate programs in SLP and audiology.

resources.label: ASHA EdFind - Graduate programs in SLP and Audiology

professions.name: Postbaccalaureate Programs
professions.tagline: Strengthen your record or change course toward health.
professions.description: Postbac programs help career-changers complete prerequisites or academic-enhancer applicants boost their record before applying to health programs.
